parameters:
I'm your guide to the basic rules that
are common to all the challenges
offered by the facilities in the Battle
Frontier.
\bWhat would you like to learn about?
\bAll the challenges at the Battle\nFrontier's facilities come in\ntwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.
\bThe Level 50 course is open to Pokémon\nup to and including Level 50.
\bPlease keep in mind, however, that\nno Trainer you face will have any\nPokémon below Level 50.
\bThis course is the entry level for\nbattles at the Battle Frontier.
\bTo begin, we hope you will challenge\nthis course.
\bThe Open Level course places no limit\non the levels of Pokémon entering\nchallenges.
\bThe levels of your opponents will\nbe adjusted to match the levels of\nyour Pokémon.
\bHowever, no Trainer you face will\nhave any Pokémon below Level 60.
\bVirtually any kind of Pokémon may take\non the challenges at all facilities.
\bEggs and certain kinds of Pokémon,\nhowever, are not permitted.
\bThe numbers of Pokémon required for\nchallenges will depend on the facility.
\bAt all facilities, however, two or more\n"of the same kind of Pokémon are not\npermitted.
\bWhen entering a challenge at a Battle\nFrontier facility, Pokémon may not\nbe holding the same kind of item.
\bPlease make sure that all Pokémon\nentering a challenge are holding\ndifferent items.
\rThe front lines of Pokémon battling!\nWelcome to the Battle Frontier!
\rWe hope you enjoy all that the Battle\nFrontier has to offer!
\rI'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the Battle Frontier.
\rWhich would you like to learn about?
\rIt is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the Battle Frontier's symbol.
\rThere are four kinds of Battle Rooms\nin the tower for Single, Double, Multi,\nand Link Multi Battles.
\rThe Battle Dome is the large building\nshaped like a huge egg.
\rEvents named Battle Tourneys are held\nin this facility.
\rThe Battle Tourneys are offered in\ntwo courses--for Single and Double\nBattles.
\rThe Battle Palace is the red building\non the right of the Battle Frontier.
\rThere are two kinds of Battle Halls\nfor Single and Double Battles.
\rThe Battle Arena is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\nthe Battle Frontier.
\rAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the Battle Arena.
\rThe Battle Factory is the large\nbuilding that is the closest to us.
\rAn event called the Battle Swap\nis conducted there.
\rThe Battle Swap event is offered in\ntwo courses for Single and Double\nBattles.
\rThe Battle Pike is the building shaped\nlike a Pokémon at the center-left of\nthe Battle Frontier.
\rAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.
\rAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.
\rThe Ranking Hall is located near\nthe Battle Tower.

There, you may see the most fantastic
records left by the Trainers that
took on the many challenges of
the Battle Frontier.
\rThe Exchange Service Corner is near\nthe Battle Tower.
\rThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe Battle Frontier may be exchanged\nfor fabulous prizes there.
\rIs it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!
\rThe front lines of Pokémon battling!\nWelcome to the Battle Frontier!
\rFor a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe Frontier Pass.
\rIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the Battle Frontier.

parameters: \PN placed the Trainer Card\nin the Frontier Pass.
\rWe hope you enjoy all that the Battle\nFrontier has to offer!
\b???: Well, if it isn't \PN!\nYou came out here!
\rGuide: Oh! Mr. Scott, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!
\bScott: It's great to see you here,\nit really is!
\bI hope you'll take your time and\nexplore everywhere.
\bNaturally, I hope you'll also experience\nthe pure essence of battling.
\bI also have my quarters here, so feel\nfree to visit if you have time.
\bI'm your guide to the Frontier Pass.
\bWhich would you like to learn about?
\bThere are seven facilities at\nthe Battle Frontier.
\bTrainers who gain recognition for\ntheir abilities may be rewarded with\nsymbols from each of the facilities.
\bTo earn a symbol, Trainers may need\nto defeat other Trainers in a row,\nand may need to win events repeatedly.
\bIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.\nI wish you the best of luck!
\bIt is possible to record one battle\non your Frontier Pass.
\bYou may record a battle you had with\na friend or friends.

Or you may record a battle conducted
at the Battle Frontier excluding
matches at the Battle Pike or
the Battle Pyramid.
\bYou may choose to record your match\nat the end of a battle.
\bBattle Points are rewards given to\nTrainers who battled outstandingly\nat the Battle Frontier.
\bYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the Exchange Service\nCorner.
\bScott: Well, hello and welcome!\nHeheh… Sorry about the cramped space.
\bAnyway, \PN, let me formally\nwelcome you to the Battle Frontier.
\bThis is my dream come true.\nIt took me years and years, but I've\nfinally given shape to my dream.
\bOn reflection, it was a terribly long\njourney…
\bI left home alone on a quest to find\nstrong Trainers.
\bNo one can imagine how much effort\nor time it took to make this real.
\bBut that's all in the past.\nNo point dwelling on that!
\bAll I want for you is to enjoy battling\nto your heart's content here.
\b\PN, I want you to have this\nas a memento for all the time our\npaths crossed on our journeys.
Scott is supposed to aware you BP based on
how many times you spoke to him through the
story of Hoenn. This is stored in \v[99].

\bScott: You can check your Battle\nPoints on your Frontier Pass.
\bThe more success you have here at\nthe Battle Frontier, the more Battle\nPoints you will collect.
\bUse your Battle Points the way you\nsee fit, like trading them for items.

\bScott: Every Trainer is an individual.\nThey all lead lives of their own.
\bBut when they're in a battle,\nit doesn't matter who they are.
\bI love the purity of battle,\nwhere everyone is equal.
\bThat's why I go everywhere seeking\nTrainers who are serious about\nbattling, and invite them here.
\bScott: Have you met any of\nthe Frontier Brains?
\bBetter yet, have you obtained any\nsymbols from them?
\bI handpicked the Frontier Brains\nas the toughest Trainers anywhere.
\bBut I'm sure that seeing how tough\nyou are will startle even them!
\bScott: You don't just train for battle,\nright?
\bI think I remember you working on\na Pokédex as well.
\bYou may run into wild Pokémon in\nthe Battle Frontier somewhere…\nFufufu!
\bScott: Are you enjoying things in\nthe Battle Frontier?
\bYour Frontier Pass!\nYou've collected the full set\nof silver symbols!
\bThat's more than impressive!\nYou are tough, just as I suspected!
\bNormally, I wouldn't do something\nlike this, but this is a special time!
\bI want you to have this.\nI'm sure you can put it to proper use.
\bScott: I hope you're enjoying\neverything in the Battle Frontier.
\bYour Frontier Pass!\nYou've gathered up the full set\nof gold symbols!
\bThat's more than stupendous!\nYou're incredible, just as I suspected!
\bI think you will be able to\nappreciate the value of my gift!
\bI must say I have the gift of knowing\na good Trainer when I see one.
\bI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!
\bScott: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the Battle Tower!\nYou beat over 50 Trainers in a row?
\bThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!
\bScott: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the Battle Tower!\nYou beat over 100 Trainers in a row?
\bThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!
\bOops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.
\bI'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!
